body: **Foco:** account for something — uso.
**Verbos:** restructure.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar account for e o verbo restructure num editorial sobre mudanças em uma empresa.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: The Company That Would Not Listen
paras: Executives will have to **account for** the decision to **restructure** the firm without consulting staff. Analysts **account for** the fall in morale by pointing to the loss of two departments; the board’s chairman **accounts for** it differently, blaming “market conditions”.

Whatever the cause, losses of this size cannot be **accounted for** by one factor. A **restructured** company needs trust. The chairman must **account for** every promise, **taking** the staff’s warnings **into consideration**. **If he had listened**, the firm **would not be** where it is today.

items.q: Staff were consulted before the restructure.
Analysts and the chairman give different accounts.
The editors think one factor explains the losses.
items.why: cannot be accounted for by one factor.

head: Uso
Exemplo
rows: Losses cannot **be accounted for** by one factor.

blocks.body: **account for** + coisa = explicar; **be accountable (to someone) for** = ser responsável por. Passiva: *cannot be accounted for*.

items.s: Losses cannot be ___ for by one factor. (account, part.)
Leaders must be ___ for their promises. (accountable)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: We will be accountable for the results

body: **Call someone to account** — Cobrar satisfações de alguém
**Hold someone accountable** — Responsabilizar alguém
**Face the music** — Encarar as consequências
**Pass the buck** — Passar a bola
**The buck stops here.** — A responsabilidade é minha.
**Take the blame** — Assumir a culpa
**Give a full account of…** — Dar um relato completo de…
**Bear responsibility for…** — Arcar com a responsabilidade por…
**Market conditions mainly.** — Principalmente as condições de mercado.
**Staff say the restructure accounts for it.** — Os funcionários dizem que a reestruturação explica isso.
**We will be accountable for the results.** — Responderemos pelos resultados.

blocks.title: Boardroom
lines: How do you account for the fall in morale?
Como você explica a queda no moral?

Os funcionários dizem que a reestruturação explica isso.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Organização da informação pela entonação

items.label: Organização da informação pela entonação
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.q: Ask someone to account for a decision.
prompts.model: How do you account for this decision?
Leaders must be accountable for their promises.
The losses cannot be accounted for by one factor.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence editorial paragraph using account for in three senses and one conditional.
blocks.model: The board must account for its decision to close two plants. Analysts account for the fall in profit by pointing to energy costs. Closures account for most job losses. The loss of trust cannot be accounted for by market conditions alone. If the board had consulted staff, the firm would be stronger now. Leaders must be accountable for their words.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
